'''Patrick Hines''' (also published as '''Pat Hines''') directed the [[2002 Yavin 4 Regionals]] (20 April 2002, Oxford, North Carolina) and wrote the director's report of it.<ref name="tr-d3592">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-21-yavin-iv-regional-directors-reportd3592/ yavin-iv-regional-directors-report], DeckTech (Patrick "ulkafett" Hines, 21 April 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-04-21-yavin-iv-regional-directors-reportd3592/ GitHub Pages].</ref> He played at [[September 2001 Raleigh tournament (South Hills Mall)]] in September 2001 with YMSYL, according to Robert Werbicki's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2999">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-27-raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fukad2999/ raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fuka], DeckTech (Robert "Turin" Werbicki, 27 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-27-raleigh-nc-john-waynes-a-bad-mutha-fukad2999/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
